### WebhookOutcome

```ts
type WebhookOutcome = 
  | "ok"
  | "invalid_signature"
  | "unknown_type"
  | "handler_error"
  | "duplicate"
  | "oversized"
  | "missing_secret";
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/webhook-guard.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/webhook-guard.ts)

How a webhook route answered a request, as its row of the delivery log
says: `ok` handled, `duplicate` a redelivery of one handled already,
`unknown_type` verified but of a type the route does not parse,
`handler_error` a handler threw (the provider retries), and
`invalid_signature`, `oversized` and `missing_secret` refused before
any signature verified.

## Variables

### IMPERSONATION\_SESSION\_SECONDS

```ts
const IMPERSONATION_SESSION_SECONDS: 1800 = 1800;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/constants.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/constants.ts)

How long a session an administrator opens by impersonating an account
lasts, in seconds: thirty minutes, the longest the package allows. Better
Auth's admin plugin keeps one an hour by default; an app's own
`admin.impersonationSessionDuration` may only shorten it. When it ends,
the administrator signs in again as themselves.

## Functions

### setupAdmin()

The implementation of both.

#### Call Signature

```ts
function setupAdmin<DM>(components, options): AdminWithReports;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/admin.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/admin.ts)

The admin console's reads: every account and every workspace, for an
administrator, read fresh from the auth tables. Each answers `null` to
anyone else: signed out, an account whose role (read fresh, never from
the token) is no administrator role, a banned or deleted one, a session
an administrator opened by impersonating someone.
The console's writes are the auth routes', held to the sensitive-action
table: banning, unbanning, setting a role and starting an impersonation
take a recent sign-in, and every one spends the per-caller `admin` limit.
Reads spend nothing: a query cannot write a bucket.

Workspaces are read-only here: an administrator acts inside one only by
impersonating a member, and an administrator's own account is never
impersonated.

##### Type Parameters

| Type Parameter | Default type |
| ------ | ------ |
| <a id="type-parameter-dm-2"></a> `DM` *extends* `GenericDataModel` | `GenericDataModel` |

##### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `components` | [`AdminComponents`](#admincomponents) |
| `options` | [`SetupAdminReportsOptions`](#setupadminreportsoptions)\<`DM`\> |

##### Returns

[`AdminWithReports`](#adminwithreports)

##### Examples

```ts [backend/admin.ts]
import { setupAdmin } from 'nuxt-backend/admin'
import { components } from './_generated/api'

const admin = setupAdmin(components)

// The reads behind useAdmin and the admin console (/admin).
export const { listUsers, getUser, listWorkspaces, getWorkspace } = admin.api
```

**With content duties: reports, the notice form and appeals**

```ts [backend/admin.ts]
import type { DataModel } from './_generated/dataModel'

// The DataModel types the reported row: `table` narrows `id` to its table's.
const admin = setupAdmin<DataModel>(components, {
  email,
  reports: {
    describe: async (ctx, { table, id }) => {
      if (table !== 'strips') return null
      const strip = await ctx.db.get('strips', id)
      return strip && { title: strip.idea, url: `/strips/${id}`, authorId: strip.authorId, files: strip.photoId ? [strip.photoId] : [] }
    },
    hide: async (ctx, { id }) => ctx.db.patch('strips', id, { hidden: true }),
  },
})
```

#### Call Signature

```ts
function setupAdmin<DM>(components, options?): Admin;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/admin.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/admin.ts)
